Class LimitKeyBaseConfig

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.config.LimitKeyBaseConfig
public abstract class LimitKeyBaseConfig extends Object
Declares the lifetime (MAX) limit keys the reusable library enforces itself, so that a key checked by grafiosch-server-base does not have to be registered by every application on top of it.

It is the library counterpart of the application's own limit key configuration and has to be called from it; the application layer stays the place that decides the whole set of caps, because it is also the only layer that can seed their default rows in a migration.

A key with no entity_limit row resolves as unlimited, so registering one here is only half the work - the default has to be seeded with the same literal, which the seed guard of the application asserts.

  • Field Details

    • ENTITY_NAME_SHARE_INVITE

      public static final String ENTITY_NAME_SHARE_INVITE
      Pseudo entity name for the read-only accounts an owner may invite into their own tenant. It is not the User entity itself: only the invited viewers are counted, never the owner and never a user of another tenant, and there is no generic create path that could enforce a User cap.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • KEY_SHARE_INVITE

      public static final LimitKey KEY_SHARE_INVITE
      Bounds how many read-only viewer accounts one tenant may create through the share mapping. Every invite of an e-mail without an account writes an enabled user row and sends an outbound mail; sharing with an existing account writes only a tenant_access row, which is keyed per user and tenant and therefore bounded already.
